instruction: What is the title of the oldest released song in my Spotify account from across my song, album and playlist libraries?
notes: Read-only query task: no database changes are demanded, only the answer. The three library scans (song, album, playlist) are nullary knowledge effects; spotify-show-song is gated on all three so the oldest song can only be identified after the full candidate set (and release dates) is known. At runtime show_song is invoked once per song-library/playlist song to read release_date and a final time for the oldest song's title; the single plan step stands for that final lookup. Pagination (page_index) is handled at runtime and not modeled. The static (oldest-released oldest-song) fact designates the answer entity; its id is only discovered through the lookups. supervisor-complete-task takes the title as the answer argument and is forced last by (not (task-completed)) on every action.
